[LIVE] Pokémon Night Out ft. Marshmello, Alison Wonderland
A Pokémon Party Like No Other
Join fellow fans for a first-of-its-kind Pokémon celebration! Pokémon Night Out will be an unforgettable dance music concert with performances by Marshmello and Alison Wonderland atop a dazzling show filled with cutting-edge technology and animation.

Can't make it in person? Livestream viewers will be treated to a DJ set from multi-instrumentalist electronic artist JVNA during the show's intermission. This set is exclusive to the Pokémon Night Out livestream, promising themed visuals, sick beats, and some fun opportunities to participate during the performance.

This livestream contains flashing or strobe lights, lasers, stage fog, and pyrotechnic effects. Viewers with photosensitivity, epilepsy, sensory sensitivities, or related medical conditions should use caution.

Learn more: https://pkmn.news/4iNtG2n
